reconcile.note: John Gill reads 'last words' in 2 Samuel 23 as David's last inspired poetry, not his last utterance, since the Solomon charge in 1 Kings 2 came later in prose.

sides.snippet: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, The man who was raised on high says, The anointed of the God of Jacob, The sweet psalmist of Israel:
sides.verseText: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, The man who was raised on high says, The anointed of the God of Jacob, The sweet psalmist of Israel:

sides.snippet: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don't let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
sides.verseText: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don't let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
